g.text: FPDAF-v2 End-to-End System Architecture & Neural Call Graph
Real-Time Bedside Telemetry Stream • SQLite Clinical Warehouse • In-Memory PyTorch BiLSTM Attention Inference
Bedside clinical telemetry cockpit for Dr. Pallavi. Displays real-time
physiological vitals (HR, MAP, SpO2, Temp) & Hour-1 SSC bundle.
Renders temporal attention distribution, Integrated Gradients
physiological attribution saliency, and counterfactual recourse.
Dispatches typed HTTP JSON requests to backend inference router:
Asynchronous clinical router: receives patient ID, extracts 24h vitals
history, invokes normalizer, and dispatches to PyTorch engine.
70 ICU Beds (50 benchmark test patients + 20 hospital records).
Forward-fill imputation for sparse laboratory measurements.
Z-score normalizes 40 features to zero-mean unit-variance tensor:
Bidirectional LSTM (128 hidden units) captures long-term trends.
Split-weight temporal attention dynamically weights critical hours.
Personalized model fine-tuned via Dynamic Drift-Aware Personalization
Runs under torch.no_grad(): computes calibrated risk logits,
extracts temporal attention weights, and computes IG saliency.
FPDAF Sepsis Clinical Decision Support System • Lead AI Engineer: Akshar • Lead Intensivist: Dr. Pallavi • Supervisors: Dr. G. R. Ramya & Dr. S. Vandhana
Amrita School of Computing • 23CSE498 Project Phase II External Review Defense
